messages:
sara: Quick async — planning to flip the routing.failover_region_v2 flag for a small canary to validate eu-west fallback & session stickiness. Targeting 5% EU traffic for 30m window starting in ~1hr. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

alex: +1 on canary but need guardrails. Can we confirm sticky session keys are honored when we reroute to eu-west? Last time some clients lost affinity and saw model mismatch.

jamal: FYI the sticky cookie is keyed on session_id + sha256(user_id). If a request is proxied to eu-west the token is valid, but our cache affinity TTL is 15m so sessions >15m may re-evaluate. We should set affinity_ttl to 1h for the canary.

lia: How do you want me to cut the flag? I can do Console toggle or CLI. CLI command is:```bash
redwood feature toggle set routing.failover_region_v2 --enable --scope=canary --audience=eu-5pct --meta '{"affinity_ttl":"3600s","canary_window":"30m"}'
```
(can also paste a curl if ops prefers)

ryan: What metrics will we watch? Propose: P95 latency for text-gen, error rate (5xx + model timeouts), and model-quality drift (sampled prompts). Set automated rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 deviance > +50ms.

alex: Add health checks: if queue depth for eu GPUs > 20 or GPU util > 85% for 2 consecutive 1m windows then circuit-break. Also enable traffic-shed to 0% if tail latency spikes.

jamal: Agree. Also check KV cache hit-rate — if it drops > 20% we might see cost spike. We can enable prefix caching sticky on canary to mitigate.

lia: ops-bot can we schedule the toggle and gate the rollout? ops-bot: scheduled_toggles created (id: sched-6782). Will run at 1784015945. Will emit events to #incidents and #eng-platform.

ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window conflicts: maintenance on eu-west infra at 1784019000. Can confirm no overlap?

sara: Good catch — maintenance is after our canary window, so ok. Lia — please proceed with CLI schedule. Leave manual rollback steps in the thread.

lia: Copy. Rollback steps: 1) redwood feature toggle set routing.failover_region_v2 --disable 2) scale down canary affinity_ttl back to 900s 3) revert routing policy to routing.fallback=legacy-region 4) notify support + customers (if incident). I'll paste commands below.

lia: ```bash
# disable flag immediately
redwood feature toggle set routing.failover_region_v2 --disable
# revert affinity
redwood config set affinity_ttl 900s --env=prod
# revert routing policy
redwood routing set-policy --name fallback --variant legacy-region
```

ryan: For visibility add a dashboard panel: failover.p95, failover.error_rate, eu-west.gpu_util, kv.hit_rate. Can someone add alerts to PagerDuty for the thresholds?

alex: I'll add P95 & error-rate PD alerts. Jamal can you add a CloudWatch alarm for GPU util?

jamal: Yep. I'll set an alarm: EU_GPU_UTIL > 85% for 2 datapoints (1m) -> pdt-eu-oncall.

sara: Ok team, timeline: +1hr prepare, schedule at 1784015945 (lia), monitor 30m, rollback criteria as above. If all green after 30m, expand to 25% over next 2 hours with same guardrails.

ryan: One more: include a sampled set of prompts for quality evals and run automated comparisons against baseline. I'll push an eval job to run every 5m during the canary.

lia: Done. I've scheduled the toggle and added the rollback commands in the runbook. Will post the exact schedule msg when ops-bot fires. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Toggle sched-6782 executed at 1784015945 by liaison. Event: routing.failover_region_v2 = enabled (audience=eu-5pct).

sara: Monitoring now. Tag me for any spike.

alex: quick note — if we see affinity mismatches, do not escalate to infra immediately; try affinity_ttl expand + prefix cache warm before rollback.

jamal: copying that into runbook.

ryan: I'll leave a short postmortem template in #postmortems if we need it.

sara: Thanks all. Will update thread at end of canary with results. :rocket:
